note.en: $100,000 to FYFL United Inc. (Community Event Support (replaces a $100,000 allocation under file 260148, which this item rescinds)), from the FY 2025-26 Discretionary Reserve. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $100,000 a FYFL United Inc. (Community Event Support (replaces a $100,000 allocation under file 260148, which this item rescinds)), del FY 2025-26 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $100,000 bay FYFL United Inc. (Community Event Support (replaces a $100,000 allocation under file 260148, which this item rescinds)), nan FY 2025-26 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $150,000 to FYFL United (Community Program Support), from the FY 2025-26 Discretionary Reserve. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $150,000 a FYFL United (Community Program Support), del FY 2025-26 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $150,000 bay FYFL United (Community Program Support), nan FY 2025-26 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $150,000 to FYFL United (Community Event Support), from the FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve. $2,325 to FYFL United (purchase-card reimbursement for donations made to the FYFL Cheerleading Competition), from the FY 2025-26 Office Funds. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $150,000 a FYFL United (Community Event Support), del FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). $2,325 a FYFL United (purchase-card reimbursement for donations made to the FYFL Cheerleading Competition), del FY 2025-26 Office Funds (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $150,000 bay FYFL United (Community Event Support), nan FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). $2,325 bay FYFL United (purchase-card reimbursement for donations made to the FYFL Cheerleading Competition), nan FY 2025-26 Office Funds (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $10,000 bay Family Action Network Movement (FANM) (Give Miami Day), nan FY 2025-26 CBO Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Sou FANM: paj Distri 2 konte a di Komisyonè Marleine Bastien te fonde l e li te direktè egzekitif li jiska desanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

subject.en: Appointment of Vicki L. Lopez to the District 5 seat
subject.es: Nombramiento de Vicki L. Lopez al escaño del Distrito 5
subject.ht: Nominasyon Vicki L. Lopez nan syèj Distri 5 la

note.en: The Commission filled the District 5 vacancy by appointment instead of calling a special election. The minutes record the vote as 7 to 5, with Steinberg, Regalado, McGhee, Bermudez and García voting no; Gilbert made the motion. Lopez, then a state representative, holds the seat until the Nov. 3, 2026 runoff, where she is on the ballot.
note.es: La Comisión llenó la vacante del Distrito 5 por nombramiento en lugar de convocar una elección especial. El acta registra el voto 7 a 5, con Steinberg, Regalado, McGhee, Bermudez y García en contra; Gilbert presentó la moción. Lopez, entonces representante estatal, ocupa el escaño hasta la segunda vuelta del 3 de noviembre de 2026, donde está en la boleta.
note.ht: Komisyon an ranpli pòs vid Distri 5 la pa nominasyon olye li rele yon eleksyon espesyal. Pwosè-vèbal la anrejistre vòt la 7 kont 5, ak Steinberg, Regalado, McGhee, Bermudez ak García ki vote non; Gilbert te pwopoze mosyon an. Lopez, ki te reprezantan Leta lè sa a, kenbe syèj la jiska dezyèm tou 3 novanm 2026 la, kote li sou bilten an.

note.en: $115,000 to FYFL United (Community Outreach and Education), from the FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $115,000 a FYFL United (Community Outreach and Education), del FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $115,000 bay FYFL United (Community Outreach and Education), nan FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: Amends R-792-25 so the annual contribution the Tropical Park Equestrian Center vendor must make (contract EVN0001892) goes to The Parks Foundation of Miami-Dade, Inc. instead of A3 Foundation, Inc. This item took A3 Foundation off the contract.
note.es: Modifica la R-792-25 para que la contribución anual que debe hacer el concesionario del Tropical Park Equestrian Center (contrato EVN0001892) vaya a The Parks Foundation of Miami-Dade, Inc. en lugar de A3 Foundation, Inc. Este asunto sacó a A3 Foundation del contrato.
note.ht: Modifye R-792-25 pou kontribisyon chak ane konsesyonè Tropical Park Equestrian Center la dwe fè (kontra EVN0001892) ale bay The Parks Foundation of Miami-Dade, Inc. olye A3 Foundation, Inc. Dosye sa a retire A3 Foundation nan kontra a.

note.en: $100,000 to FYFL United (Community Event Support), from the FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve. $150,000 to FYFL United (Community Program Support), from the FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve. $115,000 to FYFL United (Community Outreach and Education), from the FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $100,000 a FYFL United (Community Event Support), del FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). $150,000 a FYFL United (Community Program Support), del FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). $115,000 a FYFL United (Community Outreach and Education), del FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $100,000 bay FYFL United (Community Event Support), nan FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). $150,000 bay FYFL United (Community Program Support), nan FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). $115,000 bay FYFL United (Community Outreach and Education), nan FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: Moves $50,000 of Miami-Dade Rescue Plan money from Universal Medical Institute, Inc. to The FYFL United Inc. "to provide youth services." About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024.
note.es: Reasigna $50,000 del Miami-Dade Rescue Plan de Universal Medical Institute, Inc. a The FYFL United Inc. "para servicios a jóvenes". Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024.
note.ht: Transfere $50,000 nan Miami-Dade Rescue Plan soti nan Universal Medical Institute, Inc. bay The FYFL United Inc. "pou bay sèvis jèn yo". Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024.

note.en: $150,000 to FYFL United (Community Seniors Program), from the FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $150,000 a FYFL United (Community Seniors Program), del FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $150,000 bay FYFL United (Community Seniors Program), nan FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $150,000 to FYFL United (Summer Youth Internship), from the FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve. $128,000 to FYFL United (Laptop Give-A-Away Event), from the FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $150,000 a FYFL United (Summer Youth Internship), del FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). $128,000 a FYFL United (Laptop Give-A-Away Event), del FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.

subject.es: Edificio del condado cedido a FANM

note.en: Conveys the 10,800-square-foot county-owned building at 100 NE 84th Street to Family Action Network Movement, Inc. (FANM) for nominal consideration, waives FANM's past-due rent on it, and moves $752,848 of surplus bond money from the "New Haitian Community Center" project to "Future Multi-Use Facilities." About FANM: the county's District 2 page says Commissioner Marleine Bastien founded it and was its executive director until December 2024. Bastien was absent for this vote.
note.es: Cede el edificio del condado de 10,800 pies cuadrados en 100 NE 84th Street a Family Action Network Movement, Inc. (FANM) por un pago nominal, le perdona a FANM la renta atrasada y traslada $752,848 de fondos sobrantes de bonos del proyecto "New Haitian Community Center" a "Future Multi-Use Facilities". Sobre FANM: la página del Distrito 2 del condado dice que la comisionada Marleine Bastien la fundó y fue su directora ejecutiva hasta diciembre de 2024. Bastien estuvo ausente en esta votación.
note.ht: Bay bilding konte 10,800 pye kare nan 100 NE 84th Street la bay Family Action Network Movement, Inc. (FANM) pou yon pri senbolik, padone lwaye FANM te dwe sou li, epi transfere $752,848 lajan bon ki rete soti nan pwojè "New Haitian Community Center" bay "Future Multi-Use Facilities". Sou FANM: paj Distri 2 konte a di Komisyonè Marleine Bastien te fonde l e li te direktè egzekitif li jiska desanm 2024. Bastien te absan pou vòt sa a.

note.en: $150,000 to FYFL United (Community Youth Outreach), from the FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $150,000 a FYFL United (Community Youth Outreach), del FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $150,000 bay FYFL United (Community Youth Outreach), nan FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $150,000 to FYFL United (Community Outreach), from the FY 2024-25 District Designated. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $150,000 a FYFL United (Community Outreach), del FY 2024-25 District Designated (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $150,000 bay FYFL United (Community Outreach), nan FY 2024-25 District Designated (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $150,000 to FYFL United (Community Outreach), from the FY 2024-25 District Designated. $10,000 to Family Action Network Movement (FANM) (Give Miami Day (purchase-card reimbursement to The Miami Foundation)), from the FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve. Rescinds $10,000 to A3 Foundation Corp rescinds the April 2024 allocation (file 240611) About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. About FANM: the county's District 2 page says Commissioner Marleine Bastien founded it and was its executive director until December 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $150,000 a FYFL United (Community Outreach), del FY 2024-25 District Designated (en inglés). $10,000 a Family Action Network Movement (FANM) (Give Miami Day (purchase-card reimbursement to The Miami Foundation)), del FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Rescinde $10,000 a A3 Foundation Corp rescinds the April 2024 allocation (file 240611) Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Sobre FANM: la página del Distrito 2 del condado dice que la comisionada Marleine Bastien la fundó y fue su directora ejecutiva hasta diciembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $150,000 bay FYFL United (Community Outreach), nan FY 2024-25 District Designated (an angle). $10,000 bay Family Action Network Movement (FANM) (Give Miami Day (purchase-card reimbursement to The Miami Foundation)), nan FY 2024-25 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Anile $10,000 bay A3 Foundation Corp rescinds the April 2024 allocation (file 240611) Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Sou FANM: paj Distri 2 konte a di Komisyonè Marleine Bastien te fonde l e li te direktè egzekitif li jiska desanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $150,000 to FYFL United (Community Seniors Program), from the FY 2024-25 District Designated. $100,000 to FYFL United (Community Outreach), from the FY 2024-25 District Designated. $37,000 to FYFL United (Cheerleading Competition Sponsor), from the FY 2024-25 District Designated. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $150,000 a FYFL United (Community Seniors Program), del FY 2024-25 District Designated (en inglés). $100,000 a FYFL United (Community Outreach), del FY 2024-25 District Designated (en inglés). $37,000 a FYFL United (Cheerleading Competition Sponsor), del FY 2024-25 District Designated (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $150,000 bay FYFL United (Community Seniors Program), nan FY 2024-25 District Designated (an angle). $100,000 bay FYFL United (Community Outreach), nan FY 2024-25 District Designated (an angle). $37,000 bay FYFL United (Cheerleading Competition Sponsor), nan FY 2024-25 District Designated (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $200,000 to FYFL United (Spring Break Trip), from the FY 2023-24 District Designated. $150,000 to FYFL United (Summer youth internships), from the FY 2023-24 District Designated. $150,000 to FYFL United (Laptops for high school seniors), from the FY 2023-24 District Designated. $36,000 to FYFL United (Summer youth internships), from the FY 2023-24 District Designated. $9,200 to FYFL United (Sponsorship for Miami Gardens Raven Youth Football Team), from the FY 2023-24 District Designated. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $200,000 a FYFL United (Spring Break Trip), del FY 2023-24 District Designated (en inglés). $150,000 a FYFL United (Summer youth internships), del FY 2023-24 District Designated (en inglés). $150,000 a FYFL United (Laptops for high school seniors), del FY 2023-24 District Designated (en inglés). $36,000 a FYFL United (Summer youth internships), del FY 2023-24 District Designated (en inglés). $9,200 a FYFL United (Sponsorship for Miami Gardens Raven Youth Football Team), del FY 2023-24 District Designated (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $200,000 bay FYFL United (Spring Break Trip), nan FY 2023-24 District Designated (an angle). $150,000 bay FYFL United (Summer youth internships), nan FY 2023-24 District Designated (an angle). $150,000 bay FYFL United (Laptops for high school seniors), nan FY 2023-24 District Designated (an angle). $36,000 bay FYFL United (Summer youth internships), nan FY 2023-24 District Designated (an angle). $9,200 bay FYFL United (Sponsorship for Miami Gardens Raven Youth Football Team), nan FY 2023-24 District Designated (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $125,000 to FYFL United, Inc. (Laptop Give-a-Away Event), from the FY 2023-24 Discretionary Reserve Fund. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.

note.en: $24,000 to FYFL United, from the FY 2023-24 District Designated. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $24,000 a FYFL United, del FY 2023-24 District Designated (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $24,000 bay FYFL United, nan FY 2023-24 District Designated (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $500 to FYFL United, Inc. (Riverview Watcher Neighborhood Crimewatch), from the FY 2022-23 Discretionary Reserve. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $500 a FYFL United, Inc. (Riverview Watcher Neighborhood Crimewatch), del FY 2022-23 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $500 bay FYFL United, Inc. (Riverview Watcher Neighborhood Crimewatch), nan FY 2022-23 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $50,000 to FYFL United, Inc. (District 1 Summer Youth Internship Program), from the FY 2022-23 District Designated Program. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $50,000 a FYFL United, Inc. (District 1 Summer Youth Internship Program), del FY 2022-23 District Designated Program (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $50,000 bay FYFL United, Inc. (District 1 Summer Youth Internship Program), nan FY 2022-23 District Designated Program (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $90,000 to FYFL United, Inc. (District 1 Community Events and Laptop Give-A-Away Event), from the FY 2022-23 Discretionary Reserve. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $90,000 a FYFL United, Inc. (District 1 Community Events and Laptop Give-A-Away Event), del FY 2022-23 Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $90,000 bay FYFL United, Inc. (District 1 Community Events and Laptop Give-A-Away Event), nan FY 2022-23 Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

note.en: $130,000 to FYFL United (New York trip for youth, District 1 laptop giveaway and District 1 community events), from the FY 2022-23 District 1 CBO Discretionary Reserve. About FYFL United: its state corporate filings for 2022 and 2023 list Sandra Pierre-Paul as secretary and treasurer (Sunbiz N21000007320); the county's District 1 page lists her as Gilbert's deputy chief of staff. Gilbert's 2024 county campaign reported a $56,971 donation to FYFL United on Sept. 6, 2024. Other allocations in the same item are not listed here.
note.es: $130,000 a FYFL United (New York trip for youth, District 1 laptop giveaway and District 1 community events), del FY 2022-23 District 1 CBO Discretionary Reserve (en inglés). Sobre FYFL United: sus registros corporativos estatales de 2022 y 2023 nombran a Sandra Pierre-Paul como secretaria y tesorera (Sunbiz N21000007320); la página del Distrito 1 del condado la identifica como subjefa de gabinete de Gilbert. La campaña de Gilbert al condado en 2024 reportó una donación de $56,971 a FYFL United el 6 de septiembre de 2024. Otras asignaciones del mismo asunto no aparecen aquí.
note.ht: $130,000 bay FYFL United (New York trip for youth, District 1 laptop giveaway and District 1 community events), nan FY 2022-23 District 1 CBO Discretionary Reserve (an angle). Sou FYFL United: dosye korporasyon Leta 2022 ak 2023 li yo bay Sandra Pierre-Paul kòm sekretè ak trezorye (Sunbiz N21000007320); paj Distri 1 konte a bay li kòm adjwen chèf kabinè Gilbert. Kanpay Gilbert pou konte a an 2024 te rapòte yon don $56,971 bay FYFL United 6 septanm 2024. Lòt alokasyon nan menm dosye a pa parèt isit la.

name.es: Registro de cabilderos del Condado Miami-Dade

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every item the commission finally decided from November 19, 2020 (the first meeting after Commissioner Gilbert was sworn in) through October 6, 2026 that gives a named private company, developer or group a contract, lease, county land, zoning or plat approval, money or a change to an existing deal, read from the Clerk of the Board's minutes of 233 commission and zoning meetings. 2,351 final actions from November 2020 to November 2025 whose title names no private party are left out, as are routine items. Each vote comes from the minutes and was checked against the tally the clerk printed. Commissioner Lopez joined on November 18, 2025, so earlier items show her as not yet seated.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada asunto que la comisión decidió en forma final desde el 19 de noviembre de 2020 (la primera reunión después de que el comisionado Gilbert juramentó) hasta el 6 de octubre de 2026 que otorga a una empresa privada, desarrollador o grupo con nombre un contrato, arrendamiento, terreno del condado, aprobación de zonificación o de plat, dinero o un cambio a un acuerdo existente, según las actas de la Secretaría de la Junta de 233 reuniones de la comisión y de zonificación. Se dejan fuera 2351 actos finales de noviembre de 2020 a noviembre de 2025 cuyo título no nombra a una parte privada, y los asuntos de rutina. Cada voto viene de las actas y se comparó con el conteo que publicó la secretaría. La comisionada Lopez entró el 18 de noviembre de 2025, así que los asuntos anteriores la muestran como aún no en el cargo.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak dosye komisyon an te deside nèt depi 19 novanm 2020 (premye reyinyon apre Komisyonè Gilbert te prete sèman) rive 6 oktòb 2026 ki bay yon konpayi prive, yon devlopè oswa yon gwoup ki gen non yon kontra, yon lokasyon, tè konte, yon apwobasyon zonaj oswa plat, lajan oswa yon chanjman nan yon akò ki la deja, selon pwosè-vèbal Grefye Konsèy la pou 233 reyinyon komisyon ak zonaj. Nou pa mete 2351 aksyon final ant novanm 2020 ak novanm 2025 ki pa nonmen okenn pati prive nan tit yo, ni dosye woutin yo. Chak vòt soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo epi nou konpare l ak kantite vòt grefye a pibliye. Komisyonè Lopez te antre 18 novanm 2025, kidonk dosye ki vin anvan yo montre li poko te chita.
